steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope; an antidote for the poison fields.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Shovel, Rope. Recommended Antidote, Antidote Rune, or Destroy Field for Poison Fields.

steps.text: Dig open the hole of the troll cave east of Thais and go down.
steps.source: Go the Thais troll cave east of town (Mapper Coords 126.235, 126.4, 7). You will need to use a shovel to open the hole.
After entering the cave, go east and go down a hole.

steps.text: Follow the path east and down the hole.
steps.source: Follow this path east and go down into the hole.

steps.text: Go south and down to the Dead Archer, through the poison fields on either side of the slime.
steps.source: Follow this path south to find the Dead Archer. On either side of the Slime spawn, you will have to pass through some Poison Fields.
